entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metallic plane built by Karn, first called Argentum, filled with artifacts and magically animated metal creatures.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Creator of Mirrodin, who made its first three golems in his own image on his artificial plane of Argentum.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Figure who nearly wiped out Mirrodin's ancient golems when he began his grand experiment of populating the plane with soul-trapped species from other worlds.

entities.name: Golems of Mirrodin
entities.description: An ancient metallic race on Mirrodin, mostly wiped out by Memnarch.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane whose expanding rebirth strikes Mirrodin in the Scars of Mirrodin era.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Small magically animated metallic life-forms of Mirrodin; some enterprising myr generate artifact creatures.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: A high vantage point on Mirrodin from which the three ancient golems regard the landscape.

entities.name: Tangle Forest
entities.description: The coppery forest of Mirrodin where Signal Pests crawl and bound.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Area of Mirrodin searched by Thermal Navigators.

events.summary: Karn creates the first three beings, golems, on his artificial plane of Argentum, later called Mirrodin.
events.quote: The three golems in the art of Precursor Golem are meant to show the first three beings created by Karn on his artificial plane of Argentum

events.summary: Memnarch begins his grand experiment, mostly wiping out the ancient golems and populating the plane with soul-trapped species from other worlds.
events.quote: they were mostly wiped out by Memnarch when he began his grand experiment

relations.note: Karn created the first three golems
relations.quote: The three golems in the art of Precursor Golem are meant to show the first three beings created by Karn on his artificial plane of Argentum
